name: Computer Science Minor
intro: The computer science minor introduces the concepts, tools and techniques that are involved in the programming of computers. The minor prepares students to achieve mastery in several current programming languages. In addition, the student will learn about creating effective user interfaces and how to build applications that are available on the Internet.

courses.title: Introduction to Algorithms and Theory of Computing
Capstone: Design and Construction of Large Software Systems

notes: Students interested in a progressive or traditional master’s degree in Computer Science must take CSCI 201L , CSCI 270 , CSCI 356 and CSCI 350 as preparation.
Students with interests in business applications should consider CSCI 310 , CSCI 401 or CSCI 485 .
Students with interest in AI/Robotics should consider CSCI 360 , CSCI 420 or CSCI 445L .
Students with interest in networking and security should consider CSCI 353 , CSCI 430 or CSCI 476 .
Additional elective options may be available with adviser approval.
